answer: Prayers & Duties >> Hajj & Umrah Question ID: 12869 Country: India Title: If we stay in MAKKAH doing more UMRAH is best or more TAWAF is best? Question: If we stay in MAKKAH doing more UMRAH is best or more TAWAF is best? Answer ID: 12869 Posted on: Sep 1, 2020 Bismillah hir-Rahman nir-Rahim ! (Fatwa: 1168/910=H/1430) It is better to perform tawaf excessively than performing umrah if one bears as much trouble and spends as much time as one does in performing umrah. Allah (Subhana Wa Ta'ala) knows Best Darul Ifta, Darul Uloom Deoband, India
